title: Native normalized common-field functor before descent
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a scheme $X$. Use the native coefficient, its normalized coefficient presentations, and its section-module functor of [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data]. Use the raw common-stage source of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. A normalized functor consists of a commutative native coefficient structure, additive finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation for sections, the specified normalized presentations for every finite field with equality of integral structural maps under extension, and an additive triangulated functor $J$ from that source to the ordinary native derived category, with integer-shift structure. Its integral comparison is a natural isomorphism from rationalization followed by stage inclusion, $J$ and derived sections to derived extension along the specified integral-to-native map. Require its common-field arrows to equal the canonical completion comparison followed by balanced derived tensor associativity, using the literal object transports and exactly the equation commonField of the realization-data node. There is no full-faithfulness, image, or essential-smallness requirement.
